info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Status API provides essential access to the status of job applications submitted to the careers portal. Users can fetch detailed information regarding their application status, enabling effective tracking of hiring processes. This endpoint is valuable for job seekers who wish to stay updated about their application progress, and it supports functionalities like monitoring and notifications. By querying this API, developers can integrate application status checks into their applications, enhancing user experience and satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the status of their applications. It provides the latest information related to the application status, enabling users to track their progress effectively.
